texts.preamble: M/S Sri Balaji Aqua Products Situated At ... vs Union Of India Represented By Its ... on 12 September, 2014 Bench: N.Ananda, S.N.Satyanarayana -1- In The High Court Of Karnataka Gulbarga Bench Dated This The 12Th Day Of September, 2014 Present The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice N.Ananda And The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice S.N.Satyanarayana Writ Appeal No.200411/2014 (Dr) Between M/S. Sri Balaji Aqua Products Situated At Plot No.M-3, Kssidc Industrial Estate Gandhi Gunj, Bidar, By Its Partner Madhuri W/O Digambar Sindol Age:45 Years, Occ: Business R/O Bidar - 585 401. ... Appellant (By Sri Ashok B. Mulage, Advocate) And 1. Union Of India Represented By It'S Secretary Department Of Health & Family Welfare New Delhi - 110 006. 2. The Director Bureau Of India Standards Bangalore Branch, Peenya Industrial Area, 1St Stage, Bangalore - 560 001. 3. The State Of Karantaka -2- M/S
texts.facts: The appellant is manufacturing ice blocks and also selling chilled water, however not according to ISI specifications. Therefore, the concerned authorities, namely respondents herein had directed the appellant to stop activity of selling chilled water. The appellant does not have bottling unit. The appellant had not confirmed to specifications prescribed by the Bureau of Indian Standard Institutions. 2. The learned Single Judge having regard to nature of activity and failure of petitioner to take safeguards before selling chilled water, has declined to interfere with the impugned order passed by concerned authorities. 3. The appellant can not sell chilled water contrary to the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act.
